description: This file defines the ConsumerListener interface for Android's BufferQueue system, including callback methods for buffer and frame events, and interface classes for binder IPC.

classes.name: ConsumerListener
classes.description: Interface for buffer event notifications from BufferQueue to consumer.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Called when a producer disconnects from the BufferQueue.

methods.name: onFrameDequeued
methods.description: Called when a buffer slot is dequeued successfully.

methods.name: onFrameCancelled
methods.description: Called when a buffer is canceled and released back.

methods.name: onFrameDetached
methods.description: Called after a buffer is detached in asynchronous mode.

methods.name: onFrameAvailable
methods.description: Called when a new frame becomes available for consumption.

methods.name: onFrameReplaced
methods.description: Called when a queued frame replaces an existing one.

methods.name: onBuffersReleased
methods.description: Notifies that buffers have been released.

methods.name: onSidebandStreamChanged
methods.description: Notifies change in sideband buffer stream.

methods.name: addAndGetFrameTimestamps
methods.description: Provides producer timestamps and frame history.
